The individual on the left has facial hair and some wrinkling on the face, and wears a wrapped head covering that drapes down into a cloak. Their facial features are finely detailed, with the left figure having a more lined face and the right figure somewhat obscured by the fur hat. The person on the right is also wearing high, loose-fitting boots. There are no prominent accessories or jewelry visible. The background is plain with no distinct features.

artworks.title: Frontispiece for "Gloriosissimae"
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious-themed design featuring multiple classic motifs and Latin inscriptions. The central focus includes text written in Latin praising the Virgin Mary, or 'Gloriosissimae Virginis Deiparae Elogium'. Around the central text are four cherubs holding oval-shaped medallions that contain detailed scenes likely depicting biblical or allegorical imagery. The scenes include the crucifixion of Jesus, visions of Mary, a pastoral scene, and a heavenly vision. The drawing utilizes fine lines and detailed shading in a traditional engraving technique, typical of the Baroque period, capturing religious iconography and symbolism.

artworks.title: Frontispiece of the Holy Apocatastase
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 15 × 10 cm (5 7/8 × 3 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate and symbolic title page. The title page is detailed, featuring classical architectural elements such as columns and pediments. At the center is a crest with illustrative figures around, including two cherubs sitting atop the pediments. They hold within a glowing radiant vignette. Below them are classical figures dressed in detailed robes and holding objects like scrolls or staffs stand beside the columns. In the middle is the title text in French, surrounded by decorative flourishes and baroque style graphics. Below the title, there is an ornate coat of arms or emblem framed within a decorative cartouche. This drawing is in the style of early 17th-century European engravings, featuring intricate designs and calligraphy.
